name: Human
description: Humans are the most adaptable and ambitious people among the common races. They are diverse in size, skin color, and hair color.
age: Humans reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

subraces.name: Variant Human
subraces.description: Variant humans are more adaptable than their standard counterparts.
languages: One extra language of your choice

name: Elf
description: Elves are a magical people of otherworldly grace, living in the world but not entirely of it.
age: Elfs reach adulthood at about 100 and can live to be 750 years old.

subraces.name: High Elf
subraces.description: High elves have keen minds and a mastery of at least the basics of magic.
languages: One extra language of your choice

subraces.name: Wood Elf
subraces.description: Wood elves are fleet of foot and stealthy.

subraces.name: Drow
subraces.description: Drow are exiled underground, living in darkness and crafting evil magic.

name: Dwarf
description: Dwarves are known as the stalwart defenders of civilization, strong and resilient.
age: Dwarves mature at the same rate as humans but are considered young until they are 50.

subraces.name: Mountain Dwarf
subraces.description: Mountain dwarves are trained as skilled warriors.

subraces.name: Hill Dwarf
subraces.description: Hill dwarves have keen senses and deep intuition.

name: Halfling
description: Halflings are small folk known for their luck and stealth.
age: Halflings reach adulthood at 20 and live to be around 150.

subraces.name: Lightfoot Halfling
subraces.description: Lightfoot halflings can easily hide in shadows.

subraces.name: Stout Halfling
subraces.description: Stout halflings are hardier than most and resistant to poison.

name: Dragonborn
description: Dragonborn resemble other humanoid races in height, but their scales and breath weapons set them apart.
age: Dragonborn reach adulthood at 15 and live to be around 80.

name: Gnome
description: Gnomes are small folk known for their curiosity and magical aptitude.
age: Gnomes reach adulthood at 40 and can live to be over 400.

subraces.name: Forest Gnome
subraces.description: Forest gnomes have a natural affinity for illusion magic.

subraces.name: Rock Gnome
subraces.description: Rock gnomes are known as tinkers and inventors.

name: Half-Orc
description: Half-orcs combine the best traits of both their parent races, tempered by their harsh upbringing.
age: Half-orcs reach adulthood at 14 and live to be around 50.

name: Tiefling
description: Tieflings are the descendents of fiendish bloodlines, marked by their infernal heritage.
age: Tieflings reach adulthood at 18 and live to be around 100.

name: Half-Elf
description: Half-elves combine the best qualities of both parent races, with versatility in many fields.
languages: One extra language of your choice
age: Half-elves reach adulthood at 20 and live to be around 180.
